title: Restricted Fourier observation program
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $J\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, let $S\subseteq J$, and choose a sign assignment $z$ outside $J$ and sign assignments $y,y'$ on $J$. The membership-query program queries the target at the two full sign vectors obtained by combining $y,z$ and $y',z$, respectively; after receiving answers $a,a'\in\{−1,1\}$, it charges $2n+2|S|+1$ local computation steps and returns the rational restricted Fourier weight observation determined by $J,S,z,y,y',a,a'$.
